## Notable Projects

- TeenovateX Labs (https://teenovatex.org) — Platform empowering next-generation African tech creators

- EduPeak (https://edupeak-eta.vercel.app) — Modern Learning Management System
- Ilmeen (https://ilmeen-mvp.vercel.app) — AI companion for mastering Quranic Arabic
- MarcediVault (https://web3-site-kappa.vercel.app) — Multi-chain custodial wallet frontend
- MonieFlow (https://monieplow-spark.vercel.app) — Student finance management platform
- Pill-Pal (https://pill-pal-eta.vercel.app) — AI-powered medication reminder
- Empower-You (https://empower-you.vercel.app) — Personal AI companion for growth and well-being
- Kinzoku Blueprint Forge — Professional industrial prototyping tool using Gemini AI
